messages.en:
{07 02 00}Whaaaaat?!{01 00 00 0a 00} People in your
town only {07 0b 00}work one day a
week?! {01 00 00 05 00}Are you SERIOUS?!
{07 14 00}Well, whatever. {01 00 00 05 00}I'm around
seven days a week, so you
can come visit me any day!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Miiiiis?!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sinu linna
inimesed {07 0b 00}töötavad ainult

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Wowzer!{01 00 00 05 00} That sounds totally
awesome!

{07 0b 00}Hey, so is{01 00 00 05 00} the town all
filled with flowers, then?!

{04 03 00}'s mayor...

{07 06 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 05 00} See kõlab täiesti
vägevalt!

{07 00 00}Pean ütlema, et kui mina

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Aw, how can you SAY that?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
You wanna make all your
townspeople cry?!
{07 15 00}You be nice! {01 00 00 05 00}You should
pick up trash or pick weeds
for them, OK?

Kas tahad panna kõik oma
linnaelanikud nutma?!
{07 15 00}Ole kena! {01 00 00 05 00}Sa peaksid nende
eest prügi koristama või
umbrohtu kitkuma, eks?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh, whoops, that's too bad!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Although, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess that 
means it's nice and quiet{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
